proposed_urls.rationale: Section 13A01 - Scope of chapter: defines the reach of the Lobbying Disclosure Act.
Section 13A02 - Statement of intent and jurisdiction: legislative findings/intent for the lobbying-disclosure regime.
Section 13A03 - Definitions: terms (lobbyist, lobbying, principal, etc.) used throughout Ch. 13A.
Section 13A05 - Reporting: expenditure and activity reporting obligations.
Section 13A06 - Exemption from registration and reporting: scope carve-outs from the disclosure regime.
Section 13A07 - Prohibited activities: conduct restrictions tied to lobbying.
Section 13A08 - Administration: administering body and procedures for the disclosure regime.
Section 13A09 - Penalties: enforcement penalties for lobbying-disclosure violations.
Section 13A10 - Registration fees; fund established; system; regulations: fee structure, funding, and rulemaking authority for the registration system.
Section 13A11 - Nonapplicability: persons/activities to which the chapter does not apply.

notes: PA 2025 vintage available on Justia. Single-regime state: Lobbying Disclosure Act in 65 Pa.C.S. ch. 13A. Title 65 (Public Officers) chosen at pass 1; chapter-13a selected at pass 2 (chapter-13 marked 'Deleted by amendment' as the repealed prior regime; chapter-11 Ethics Standards excluded as general public-officer ethics, not lobbying-coupled). Pass 3 exposed 11 per-section leaves 13A01-13A11, identical to PA 2015 ground truth (same section count, same numbering, same titles). Tree depth 3: state -> title -> chapter -> section. No Cloudflare or Playwright errors.
